newsitem.title: USA: US crudes lose short covering aid, prices retreat.
newsitem.headline: US crudes lose short covering aid, prices retreat.

text.p: U.S. crude prices faltered Tuesday morning, retreating after a short covering rally ran its course, leaving outright prices much weaker and domestic grades a shade lower, traders said.

May NYMEX futures expire at the end of today's session, resulting in a volatile paper market. May West Texas Intermediate/Cushing was around 40 cents lower at $19.90-20.00 a barrel, giving back the gains established on Monday.
"The people who were short in the market did all of their covering already, leaving the market weaker," said a cash trader. Wide WTI/Brent spreads have also factored into play.
